traditional: the Sun trine Mars: a soft contact. Vitality, authority, and recognition supports action, conflict, and heat - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Identity meets drive and aggression. Energy, assertion, and the will to act become central to the sense of self. The trine makes this a natural strength: Action with little temper behind it. Things get done and the drive feels available rather than volatile. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Selfhood and drive flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what selfhood and drive have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Initiative and drive; the cost is friction with authority and a tendency to force things.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and anger and recklessness go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: You may know exactly what you want to do before you have finished talking yourself out of it, and for once that first instinct may deserve more credit.
readerCopy.body: You may know exactly what you want to do before you have finished talking yourself out of it, and for once that first instinct may deserve more credit. When the Sun trines Mars, confidence and action cooperate, making it easier to move on a decision without the usual drag between knowing what you want and actually doing something about it. Use the energy on the move you have been postponing because it requires nerve, not on creating urgency where none exists. Acting decisively feels different when the action is aligned with something you already know matters.
